create.name: Theresa Reed
create.bio:
Theresa Reed, known online as The Tarot Lady, has worked with tarot and astrology for around forty years. She bought her first deck as a teenager in a Catholic household where omens and superstition were part of family life, and went on to give readings to thousands of clients. Her approach is plain-spoken and practical: she treats the cards and the chart as tools for seeing a situation clearly and making better choices, not as fixed fate, and she avoids jargon in favour of everyday language.

In recent years she has stepped back from public readings to concentrate on writing and teaching. Her books include Twist Your Fate, Astrology for Real Life, The Book of Astrological Returns, Tarot: No Questions Asked, The Weiser Tarot Journal and The Tarot Coloring Book, and she co-created The Uncommon Tarot deck with Shaheen Miro. She teaches online courses in astrology and tarot technique, has taught at a tarot conference at the Omega Institute, publishes free monthly forecasts and card-by-card tarot meanings on her site, and mentors writers who want to publish books on spiritual subjects. She co-hosts the Talking Shop podcast with Briana Saussy and is based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

books.title: Astrology for Real Life
books.author: Theresa Reed
books.description: A beginner's guide to reading a birth chart, written in a casual, jargon-free voice. It covers signs, planets, houses and aspects with everyday examples.

books.title: The Book of Astrological Returns: Your Complete Guide to Every Life Cycle from the Sun to Pluto
books.author: Theresa Reed
books.description: A reference on planetary returns, explaining what each cycle, from the yearly solar return to the long Saturn and Pluto cycles, can mean for a person's life and how to work with it.

books.title: Twist Your Fate: Manifest Success with Astrology and Tarot
books.author: Theresa Reed
books.description: Shows how to combine tarot spreads and astrological timing to plan changes, choose good moments to act and move a stuck situation forward.

books.title: Tarot: No Questions Asked: Mastering the Art of Intuitive Reading
books.author: Theresa Reed
books.description: A guide to reading tarot intuitively while keeping a solid grounding in the traditional meanings, with exercises for building confidence as a reader.

books.title: The Weiser Tarot Journal
books.author: Theresa Reed
books.description: A structured journal for recording readings and reflections, usable with any deck, with prompts and pages designed to track a tarot practice over time.

books.title: The Tarot Coloring Book
books.author: Theresa Reed
books.description: Line drawings of all seventy-eight cards to colour in, each paired with notes on its symbolism, as a hands-on way for beginners to learn the deck.

courses.title: Astrology School (8-week foundational course)
courses.description: An eight-week online course run with 22 Teachings that covers the building blocks of astrology so students can interpret a chart with confidence.

courses.title: Advanced Tarot Techniques
courses.description: A four-week online course that adds astrological correspondences, decans and other advanced methods to an existing tarot practice, with replays for those who miss a live class.

courses.title: Book Mentoring with Theresa Reed
courses.description: Three one-to-one sessions and a short astrology reading for people writing a book on tarot, astrology or other spiritual topics, covering proposals, publishers, contracts and making time to write.

free_resources.title: Tarot Card by Card
free_resources.description: Her free card-by-card guide to tarot meanings, including reversals and practical advice for each card.

free_resources.title: Monthly Forecasts and Horoscopes
free_resources.description: Free monthly astrological forecasts that walk through the month's main transits, new and full moons and what they may bring.

free_resources.title: Tarot by the Mouthful
free_resources.description: A free series, made with a food-loving co-author, that pairs each tarot card with a recipe, a story and reflections on its meaning.
